technique: Scope-governance over universal formulas
relevant_scope: Any category selection or adaptation; document category and medium assumptions
exclusions: No universal structure duration or retention mechanism follows from scope metadata

technique: Assertions calibrated to available evidence
relevant_scope: Reported nonfiction history, weather, technology, news, finance, psychology
exclusions: Fiction may invent but must not present invention as verified fact

technique: Atomic claim decomposition and numerical QA
relevant_scope: Stat-heavy aviation, education, finance, public forecast, journalism
exclusions: Not a requirement to decompose every fictional poetic metaphor

technique: Accurate captions plus meaningful non-speech information
relevant_scope: Captioned multimedia including shorts, documentary, education and accessible exports
exclusions: Cannot infer automatic subtitles are accurate; not equivalent to a style rule that removes relevant sounds

technique: Separate audience-retention analytics from raw starts/views
relevant_scope: All YouTube format performance interpretation especially Shorts and post-Aug-2026 comparisons
exclusions: Do not infer script merit or retention curves from public view counts

technique: Subject consent privacy and asymmetric harm checks
relevant_scope: Documentary interviews, trauma history, vulnerable sources and personal stories
exclusions: Fictional consenting-source constraints differ; do not imply rights fully cleared

technique: Separate drafts, research and independent verification
relevant_scope: Evidence-rich nonfiction and high-consequence advice
exclusions: Not proof that one exact editorial pipeline outperforms all workflows

technique: Start in active moral dilemma
relevant_scope: Character-centred historical portrait and dramatic nonfiction after fact-check
exclusions: Not mandatory for geographic context, service alerts or abstract explainer

technique: Lead with engineering or institutional paradox
relevant_scope: Aviation engineering explainers and defense acquisition analysis
exclusions: Not a universal hook for psychology, fiction or urgent weather updates

technique: Lead with actionable what/where/when
relevant_scope: Time-sensitive severe weather and public service updates
exclusions: Withholding imminent risk for cliffhanger is inappropriate

technique: Self-recognition or relatable problem framing
relevant_scope: General-audience psychology and education essays
exclusions: Not evidence that direct callout is clinically sound or universally welcomed

technique: Reveal useful central answer once premises suffice
relevant_scope: Explanatory journalism and educational why-video after essential caveats
exclusions: Some narrative mysteries legitimately delay outcome; early answer must not omit hazard

technique: Deferred significance of sourced clues
relevant_scope: Mystery, dramatic biography, technical puzzle
exclusions: Do not obscure urgent warnings or use invented evidence as mystery device

technique: Three-act as optional model
relevant_scope: Preplanned dramatic story arcs and some long explanatory narratives
exclusions: Not required for essayistic metaphor, direct weather alert or all documentary workflows

technique: Scene-sequel reaction/decision cycles
relevant_scope: Fiction scenes and character-centered dramatization with credible agent choices
exclusions: Not applicable as compulsory structure to charts-only explainers or forecast bulletins

technique: Modular sectional explanation with cross-section continuity
relevant_scope: Long technical explainers and series with distinct mechanisms
exclusions: A very short essay or urgent briefing may not need explicit sections

technique: Alternating tension/recovery matched to narrative purpose
relevant_scope: Fiction, narrative documentary and some emotional exposition
exclusions: Public news warnings and tightly scoped tutorials can prioritize clarity

technique: Payoff obligation and fair setup resolution
relevant_scope: Mystery, suspense, explainers with an explicit promise
exclusions: Breaking news may end provisional rather than resolving a future outcome

technique: Speakable sentences and visible transition links
relevant_scope: VO scripts especially technical and international-audience explanations
exclusions: One-idea-per-sentence rigidness can flatten creative voice and omit context

technique: Voice consistency while tone shifts with subject
relevant_scope: Series narration, character/brand identity and expert explainers
exclusions: One narrator voice is not required in multi-voice documentary or interviews

technique: Control jargon and scaffold for novice/expert audience
relevant_scope: Physics, finance, psychology and education tailored to declared prior knowledge
exclusions: Overexplaining can irritate experts; analogy may falsify mechanisms

technique: Integrate spoken reference with required visuals
relevant_scope: Map forecasts, annotated aircraft diagrams, instructional screencasts
exclusions: Written transcript alone cannot determine whether deictic this/that is clear

technique: Meaning-preserving localization and register matching
relevant_scope: Multilingual VO and audience-specific German/English adaptations
exclusions: Avoid absolute ban on borrowed words or imposed formality (F-092 FAIL)

technique: Use one metaphor coherently where it clarifies
relevant_scope: Reflective psychology essay and accessible concept illustration
exclusions: Metaphor alone cannot verify neuroscience or replace emergency guidance

technique: Do not fabricate human nonfiction dialogue/characters
relevant_scope: Reported human history, journalism, biographies and interviews
exclusions: Historical BBC wildlife compression exception does not authorize fabricated human quotes

technique: Dated forecasting and uncertainty disclosure
relevant_scope: Time-sensitive weather forecasts and mutable breaking news
exclusions: Not a deterministic narrative promise or undated evergreen statistic

technique: Separate contract award from operational aircraft capability
relevant_scope: Defense procurement/aviation acquisition news analysis
exclusions: Cannot infer future production specs or deployment from award headline

technique: Proof of historical time/place/quotation
relevant_scope: Emotion-first WWI/WWII documentary, memoir and biographical reconstruction
exclusions: A reported story clock 10:37 cannot substitute for elapsed YouTube timeline

technique: Mechanism-level psychology evidence review
relevant_scope: Psychology/neuroscience popularization and self-help explanation
exclusions: Comedic personification not anatomical or clinical evidence

technique: MOOC short-video engagement association
relevant_scope: Specific edX courses/video production conditions reported in 2014 study
exclusions: Does not prove 6-minute ceiling, YouTube watch lift or script-only cause

technique: Listening modality can change comprehension
relevant_scope: Synthetic-audio versus displayed health texts for sampled US workers
exclusions: Cannot set YouTube VO sentence quotas or predict natural human narration effects

technique: Match financial lesson to decision/task and risk
relevant_scope: Beginner investment education versus consumer-finance educator resources
exclusions: Video galleries prove topic coverage not script effectiveness

technique: Live play-by-play reorientation and recap
relevant_scope: Live radio sports commentary or broadcast with score drift
exclusions: STAA timing suggestions are not valid YouTube retention loop quotas

technique: Truth-preserving wildlife sequence compression exception
relevant_scope: Certain natural-history sequences under transparent, non-misleading 2012 BBC guidance
exclusions: Not license for invented reported humans, dialogue or unmarked event conflation

technique: Fair-play clue planting
relevant_scope: Fictional mysteries with discoverable clue logic
exclusions: Journalistic factual mysteries cannot invent evidence or hide material warnings

technique: Controlled uncanny detail/dread
relevant_scope: Horror fiction and psychological thriller storytelling
exclusions: Not universal for public hazard briefings, reportage or business explainers

technique: Text-first modular narrative authoring
relevant_scope: Branching interactive fiction and game dialogue authored before visual implementation
exclusions: Not a requirement for linear VO videos or live play-by-play

technique: Match resolution to viewer intent rather than forced CTA
relevant_scope: Practical forecast wrap-up, explanatory video bridge, historical reflection, poetic essay
exclusions: Not every ending needs steps or next-video bridge

technique: Position sponsor/engagement without asserting retention effect
relevant_scope: Monetized YouTube narration with CTA or sponsorship
exclusions: No categorical ban on early CTA nor proof early CTA is optimal

technique: Avoid universal loop/payoff seconds quotas
relevant_scope: Diagnostic challenge to F-181's 60–90-second loop and F-180's 8–12-minute template
exclusions: Cannot establish any optimal cadence from untimed captions or R141 radio commentary

technique: No caption-only inference about performance or pauses
relevant_scope: All 12 V cases where only written spoken text available
exclusions: Do not report audio delivery, edit cadence or speaker identity from transcript

technique: Keep script-quality rubric separate from effectiveness
relevant_scope: Expert writing-review pilots across categories and practical creator experiments
exclusions: High rubric scores cannot demonstrate uplift in CTR, AVD, satisfaction or retention

technique: Adversarial claim checking and review stop condition
relevant_scope: High-stakes nonfiction, empirical claims, scripts with synthetic drafting
exclusions: Style-only feedback cannot substitute for fact and rights checking

technique: Audience intent and expertise segmentation before comparison
relevant_scope: Novice education, DACH historical empathy, weather hazard action, expert aviation audience
exclusions: No single retention metric or persona represents all audiences

technique: Rhythm and punctuation depend on performance
relevant_scope: VO scripts read by natural human narrators and literary narration
exclusions: Em dash frequency not empirical AI detector; caption punctuation may be automated

technique: Semantic function mapping before visuals
relevant_scope: Image-based or map-based documentary/explainer production
exclusions: A script-only caption review cannot validate visual mapping quality

technique: Verify date/entity and longitudinal consistency
relevant_scope: Serial journalism, historical multi-character arcs, long technical projects
exclusions: Consistency does not independently certify factuality

technique: Core message framing without 15-word mandate
relevant_scope: Short explainers, editorial briefs and video concept reviews
exclusions: A multi-claim emergency briefing or nuanced documentary may not compress fairly
